description: Check a Solana token for rug-pull and scam risk. Input: a mint address, a pump fun or DexScreener link, or a $TICKER. Returns a 0-100 risk score (0-29 low risk, 30-59 caution, 60-100 high risk), plain-English red flags (mint/freeze authority, Token-2022 extensions, holder concentration, dev wallet and its launch history, linked insider wallets, LP lock, honeypot sell test, liquidity, drawdown) and a dump-model probability for tokens under 6 hours old. Read-only: never needs a wallet connection or signature. Free: 5 checks/day per IP (shared with the REST API); Pro key: unlimited. Automated risk signals, not financial advice. A low score is not a recommendation to buy.

api_key.description: RugRadar Pro API key (optional; alternatively send Authorization: Bearer <key>).
